username.description: Registry user; also used to obtain tokens from the registry's token service

password.description: Password or personal access token of the user

token.description: Bearer token sent as is to the registry, instead of username and password

insecure.description: Talk to the registry over plain HTTP

tls_insecure_no_verify.description: Disable TLS certificate verification (dangerous; use only for testing)

allow_cross_host_uploads.description: Follow upload locations that point to another host than the registry
